original:
Let $\ell\equiv 1\pmod{4}$ and $p\equiv 1\pmod{4}$ be distinct primes, let
 $n\geq 1$ , and suppose that $p$ generates $(\mathbb{Z}/\ell^{n}\mathbb{Z})^{\times}$ . Put

 $m_{j}=\ell^{j-1}(\ell-1)\qquad(1\leq j\leq n).$ 

Then

(2)

 $P_{\mathcal{H}_{\ell^{n}},p}(X)=\prod_{j=1}^{n}\left(X^{m_{j}}+p^{m_{j}/2}\right).$ 

For a positive integer $r$ , the curve $\mathcal{H}_{\ell^{n}}$ is maximal over
 $\mathbb{F}_{p^{r}}$ if and only if $r=m_{n}b$ with $b$ positive and odd. It is
minimal over $\mathbb{F}_{p^{r}}$ if and only if $r=2m_{n}b$ with $b\geq 1$ .
